changeSet.author: nexus-o8dil.12
changeSet.comment: RDR-191 Phase 4: create nexus.chunks, copy all rows from chunks_384/768/1024, build all indexes, drop the three sources — ONE transaction (N3), copy-THEN-index (N4), lock-first (N2). See file header for the full derivation.
changeSet.sql: DO $$ DECLARE collision_count bigint; BEGIN SELECT COUNT(*) INTO collision_count FROM ( SELECT tenant_id, collection, chash FROM nexus.chunks_384 INTERSECT SELECT tenant_id, collection, chash FROM nexus.chunks_768 UNION ALL SELECT tenant_id, collection, chash FROM nexus.chunks_384 INTERSECT SELECT tenant_id, collection, chash FROM nexus.chunks_1024 UNION ALL SELECT tenant_id, collection, chash FROM nexus.chunks_768 INTERSECT SELECT tenant_id, collection, chash FROM nexus.chunks_1024 ) collisions; IF collision_count > 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'RDR-191 unify (vectors-004-1): % cross-shard (tenant_id, collection, chash) collision(s) found -- the unified PK cannot represent a triple present in more than one dim shard (N7, T2 22408). Resolve the collision (dedupe or re-embed under a single dim) before retrying this migration.', collision_count; END IF; END $$;

CREATE TABLE nexus.chunks ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, collection TEXT NOT NULL, chash BYTEA NOT NULL, chunk_text TEXT NOT NULL, embedding_384 vector(384), embedding_768 vector(768), embedding_1024 vector(1024), chunk_tsv tsvector GENERATED ALWAYS AS (to_tsvector('english', chunk_text)) STORED, metadata JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT chunks_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, collection, chash), CONSTRAINT exactly_one_embedding CHECK (num_nonnulls(embedding_384, embedding_768, embedding_1024) = 1) );
ALTER TABLE nexus.chunks ADD CONSTRAINT chunks_chash_octet_check CHECK (octet_length(chash) = 32) NOT VALID;
DROP TABLE nexus.chunks_384, nexus.chunks_768, nexus.chunks_1024 CASCADE;

rollback.sql: CREATE TABLE nexus.chunks_384 ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, collection TEXT NOT NULL, chash BYTEA NOT NULL, chunk_text TEXT NOT NULL, embedding vector(384) NOT NULL, chunk_tsv tsvector GENERATED ALWAYS AS (to_tsvector('english', chunk_text)) STORED, metadata JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT chunks_384_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, collection, chash) ); CREATE TABLE nexus.chunks_768 ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, collection TEXT NOT NULL, chash BYTEA NOT NULL, chunk_text TEXT NOT NULL, embedding vector(768) NOT NULL, chunk_tsv tsvector GENERATED ALWAYS AS (to_tsvector('english', chunk_text)) STORED, metadata JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT chunks_768_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, collection, chash) ); CREATE TABLE nexus.chunks_1024 ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, collection TEXT NOT NULL, chash BYTEA NOT NULL, chunk_text TEXT NOT NULL, embedding vector(1024) NOT NULL, chunk_tsv tsvector GENERATED ALWAYS AS (to_tsvector('english', chunk_text)) STORED, metadata JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT chunks_1024_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, collection, chash) );
ALTER TABLE nexus.chunks NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
